items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the comparison between intersection numbers and degrees of iterated Chern class caps at source lines 5212-5226, label lemma-degrees-and-numerical-intersections, whose proof occupies source lines 5228-5265. The proof first reduces to an integral space by decomposing the cycle into its components with multiplicities and invoking the same decomposition for the intersection number through the leading term of the numerical polynomial, and then does real geometric work: Chow's lemma supplies a proper morphism that is an isomorphism over a dense open subspace and has a scheme as source, the source is replaced by the scheme theoretic closure of the preimage of that open subspace so that it remains integral, and both sides are checked to be unchanged, the cycle side through the projection formula for capping with a first Chern class. The scheme case is then quoted. The counted statement records neither the decomposition nor the passage to a scheme.
